correctness.rationale: Exact utility factorization bounds every distance penalty in [0,Dq(1-q^(n-1))], so the strict sufficient condition makes orbit length decisively monotonic for any unilateral change. The exhaustive constructive functional-graph lemma excludes all non-Hamiltonian Nash outcomes, and Hamiltonian cycles cannot be improved. The all-abstain event proves the n q^n loss lower bound. The three-player sign condition follows by checking all eight loop-free profiles. Exact-rational finite tests corroborate but are not used as infinite proof.
